1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable letter and line spacing, though the spacing is standard rather than notably generous.

2.why: An all-caps 'STEP 1 OF 5' label appears on every screen, though the body instructions otherwise avoid italics and dense blocks.

3.why: Content sits in a single centred column with large fields and button that read well at mobile width, though secondary helper text is small.

4.why: Instructions are a single short sentence ('Confirm your bank account details to protect higher-value payments'), though 'MFA enrolment' is unexplained jargon.

5.why: Both fields are prefilled with example values and helper text explicitly says 'Assessment demo: use the displayed example details.'

6.why: The longest text on any screen is one short sentence; no long blocks of text appear anywhere.

7.why: No codes or secrets are ever displayed — the flow stalls at sign-in across all four screenshots — and no copy affordance exists.

8.why: No QR code or any alternative to manual entry appears on any of the four screens.

9.why: Standard text inputs are shown, but there is no password field and no visible evidence confirming autofill or password-manager support.

10.why: A 'STEP 1 OF 5' indicator and a large blue 'Continue securely' button identify the step and primary action, though the step label itself is small.

11.why: Every screen presents exactly one primary action, the 'Continue securely' button.

12.why: The only post-action feedback is the error 'Unable to sign in with those details,' which does not state what comes next, and no success feedback is ever shown.

13.why: Repeated attempts appear possible with no visible lockout or penalty, but there are no reveal, hide, or re-request code controls because no codes are ever issued.

14.why: The error 'Unable to sign in with those details' avoids blaming the user but gives no indication of what is wrong or how to fix it.

15.why: No timer or time limit appears on any screen, though no code-entry step was ever reached to confirm generous entry time.
